ANSWER:
Repository (view) validity is a single internal gate in `src/view/validity.rs`. It computes a `validity_key` — a SHA-256 (`digest::content_digest`) over the serialized `ValidityInputs`, which bundles the schema tag plus five fingerprints: the content fingerprint, the analyzer fingerprint, the snapshot-config digest, and the link/candidate/graph producer-policy fingerprints (`src/view/validity.rs:26-42`, collected in `ValidityInputs::current` at :78-94, hashed in `key()` at :97-99). The derived index is stored under `indexes/{key[7..23]}` (`src/view/validity.rs:145-147`), so a directory hit already implies all inputs match; a stored `validity.json` records the components for diagnostics. `ensure_index` recomputes the manifest and inputs, and `index_valid` accepts reuse only when `graph/manifest.json` exists AND the stored inputs equal the current ones via `ValidityInputs::validate` (`src/view/index.rs:245-258, 263-294`), which reports bounded reasons like SOURCE_CHANGED / ANALYZER_CHANGED / CONFIG_CHANGED (`src/view/validity.rs:122-142`).

Fingerprint source: `ViewManifest::fingerprint()` in `src/view/manifest.rs` — a SHA-256 digest over the canonical, sorted `path → language → content_digest` lines of every source file plus `meta path → content_digest` lines for the consulted metadata inputs (`go.mod`, `Cargo.toml`). It is the view's authoritative content identity, independent of cwd, branch, or HEAD. Its per-file digests come from `digest::content_digest` (SHA-256, `src/repository/digest.rs:24-38`). The analyzer fingerprint (`AnalyzerFingerprint::current`, `src/repository/fingerprint.rs:79-98`) covers schema + ANALYSIS_ABI_VERSION + tree-sitter ABI + each grammar's crate name/version; link/candidate/graph fingerprints hash their own schema/policy versions (`src/links/model.rs:647-659`, `src/candidates/model.rs:434-447`, `src/graph/model.rs:168-177`).
